title: Two bells, one moment
description: Two temple bells, teal and amber, each with a row of ring marks; the first marks line up in purple and the later ones do not.

title: Idli and vada hops
description: A number line from 0 to 15 with five teal hops of 3 above and three amber hops of 5 below, both reaching 15.

title: Common multiples of 3 and 5
description: Two overlapping circles for multiples of 3 and multiples of 5, with 15 and 30 in the overlap.

title: Eights sit on fours
description: A line from 0 to 32 with 8 amber dots for multiples of 4 and 4 teal dots for multiples of 8 directly above four of them.

title: Jump of 4 lands on 24
description: A number line from 0 to 24 with six equal teal jumps of 4 ending on a purple star at 24.

title: Jumps for 14 and 36
description: Four tiles for the factors of 14, with 1 and 2 in purple and bracketed because they also divide 36.

title: Figs in boxes
description: A teal grid of 12 dots in 3 rows of 4 beside an amber single row of 7 dots.

title: Rows times columns
description: A grid of 12 teal dots in 2 rows and 6 columns with brackets for the rows and columns.

title: Primes and composites 21 to 30
description: A row of tokens 21 to 30 with 23 and 29 teal and the other eight amber, labelled 2 primes and 8 composite.

title: Crossing out multiples of 2
description: Boxes 1 to 10 in a row: 2 circled in teal, 1 and the multiples 4, 6, 8, 10 crossed in grey, 3, 5, 7, 9 plain.

title: Why circled numbers are prime
description: A card with 7 circled and factors 1 and 7, beside a card with 6 crossed out and factors 1, 2, 3, 6.

title: A safe pair of numbers
description: Number 4 in teal with factors 1, 2, 4 and number 9 in amber with factors 1, 3, 9; the only common factor is 1.

title: Safe or not safe
description: Pair 15 and 39 with common factor 3 marked, labelled not safe, beside pair 18 and 29 labelled safe.

title: First common multiple
description: Number line 0 to 15 with 5 teal jumps of 3 above and 3 amber jumps of 5 below, both meeting at 15.

title: Hidden common factor
description: Two rows: 56 = 7 × 8 and 63 = 7 × 9 with both sevens highlighted, labelled 7 is common.

title: Same primes, any order
description: Two rows of prime circles 3, 3, 7 and 3, 7, 3, each with two teal 3s and one amber 7.

title: Join the prime factors
description: Three teal dots for 12 and two amber dots for 6 join into one row of five dots that stands for 72.

title: No shared prime factor
description: A row of five teal dots for 80 and a row of three amber dots for 63, with no shared factor between them.

title: Does it fit inside
description: A row of five dots for 48 with a bracket around the first three dots that make 12.

title: Quick checks for 8560
description: The number 8560 above five circles marked 2, 4, 5, 8 and 10.

title: Multiples of 5
description: Four tiles showing 5, 10, 15 and 20 with each last digit highlighted.

title: Even last digits
description: Five circles showing 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 with each last digit highlighted.

title: Same last digit
description: Twelve dots make three full groups of 4; twenty two dots make five groups of 4 with 2 left over.

title: Look at the last two
description: Three numbers whose last two digits are 32, highlighted, each a multiple of 4.

title: Check 4 with two digits
description: The number 8536 as four boxes with the last two digits 3 and 6 highlighted, and the line 36 = 4 × 9 below.

title: Same ending, different answer
description: Two rows of digit boxes, 108 and 208, both ending in 08 highlighted; 208 = 8 × 26 while 108 is not a multiple.

title: Last three digits for 8
description: Three numbers 128, 1128 and 3128 whose last three digits 128 are highlighted, with the line all divisible by 8.

title: Change the last two digits
description: The number 8552 as four boxes: 85 kept in teal and the new last two digits 52 in amber, with 8552 = 8 × 1069 below.

title: Four numbers in a box
description: Four equal cards showing 9, 16, 25 and 43 in a row, with the line each one is special below.

title: A prime product puzzle
description: An empty 2 by 2 grid with row products 6 and 10 on the right and column products 10 and 6 below, headed fill with primes.

title: The 3 by 3 prime grid
description: An empty 3 by 3 grid with row products 8, 105, 70 on the right and column products 30, 70, 28 below.
